references.text: Mentions Ekron as one of the five Philistine cities, also mentioned in this text regarding Judah's territory
Continuation of the description of the territory that includes Ashdod and its villages, directly linked to this verse
Describes Ashdod as a Philistine city where the Ark of the Covenant was brought, the same city mentioned in this verse
Lists Ekron and Ashdod among the Philistine cities, the same cities mentioned in the boundary description
Prophesies judgment against Ashdod, one of the cities mentioned in Joshua's boundary description
Prophesies that Ekron will be uprooted, the city marking the border in this verse
Mentions both Ekron and Ashdod in a prophecy concerning the fate of the Philistines
